note: Seed priors from short-form best practice. Rules with source "prior" are unconfirmed by this channel's data; the analytics engine (M5) confirms, refutes or adds rules from real performance.

hookStyles.cold_open: Start inside the moment, mid-action, with a concrete image ("June 1978. A boy stands on an empty road.")
hookStyles.shocking_fact: Lead with the single most surprising true fact, stated flatly
hookStyles.question: Open with a question the viewer needs answered ("Why did nobody notice for 13 years?")
hookStyles.stakes: Name what is about to be lost or decided ("One wish. Three men. All of them regretted it.")
hookStyles.quiet_detail: Open on a small, eerie, specific detail and let it hang

rules.rule: Line 1 is 5–9 words and makes sense with the sound off (the caption carries it).
No channel intro, greeting or 'today we look at' — start in the story.
A date, place or name appears in the first two lines to ground the story.
Exactly one turn; the line before it is the quietest.
Average 6–9 spoken words per line; no line over 12.
Series parts end on an open question or image (cliffhanger); single stories end on a resonant fact, not a summary.
True crime: at least one line about who the victim was as a person.
